simple.meaning: גָּזִית (gâzîyth) is a Hebrew object word meaning “something cut , i.e. dressed stone.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Exodus 20:25. The surrounding context includes family line, altar, land, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גָּזִית (H1496) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: גָּזִית (gâzîyth) / H1496 is traced through Exodus 20:25, 1 Kings 5:31, 1 Kings 6:36, 1 Kings 7:9 with generated occurrence evidence.

firstOccurrence.englishText: If you make me an altar of stone, you shall not build it of cut stones; for if you lift up your tool on it, you have polluted it.

majorEvents.label: Movement or place
majorEvents.evidenceText: David gave orders to gather together the foreigners who were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to cut dressed stones to build God’s house.

majorEvents.label: Offering
majorEvents.evidenceText: There were four tables for the burnt offering, of cut stone, a cubit and a half long, and a cubit and a half wide, and one cubit high. They laid the instruments with which they killed the burnt offering and the sacrifice on them.

timeline.evidenceText: If you make me an altar of stone, you shall not build it of cut stones; for if you lift up your tool on it, you have polluted it.
He built the inner court with three courses of cut stone and a course of cedar beams.
All these were of costly stones, even of cut stone, according to measure, sawed with saws, inside and outside, even from the foundation to the coping, and so on the outside to the great court.
Above were costly stones, even cut stone, according to measure, and cedar wood.
The great court around had three courses of cut stone, and a course of cedar beams; like the inner court of Yahweh’s house and the porch of the house.

definitions.full: H1496. gazith גָּזִית noun feminine a cutting, hewing — גָּזִית Exod 20:25 10 t., always absolute; — hewing , ג ׳אַבְנֵי = hewn stones (building-stones) 1 Kings 5:31; 1Chr 22:2 ; Ezek 40:42 (for tables), compare ג כְּמִדּוֺת יְקָרוֺת ׳אֲבָנִים 1Kin 7:9 , 11 (but Klo strike out as gloss, compare ᵐ5 ); also without אבני = hewn stones Exod 20:25 (altar) Amos 5:11 ( ג ׳בָּֽתֵּי ) Isa 9:9 (opposed to לְבֵנִים ); ג ׳טוּרֵי 1Kin 6:36 , ג ׳טוּרִים 7:12 ; also Lam 3:9 בְּג דַּרְכִּי ׳גָּדַר . גִּזָּה see below גזז . below
